facts.text: The Johnson Scholarship covers full tuition, room, and board, plus $10,000 in summer funding for up to 44 incoming students each year, representing about 10% of the first-year class.

sources.title: The Johnson Scholarship | Washington and Lee University
sources.quote: Johnson Scholarships cover tuition and fees, housing and food, and $10,000 in funding for a summer experience — a grand total of more than $89,000 per year.
